stories.headline: Vance outplays QB1 in closed scrimmage
stories.body: Redshirt freshman Yusuf Vance went 14-of-16 against the first-team defense Thursday. Staffers say the huddle noticed. Key Lomax pressed all afternoon and threw two picks trying to answer.

stories.headline: Ellery trims list to three — you made the cut
stories.body: Four-star S Colt Ellery named his finalists and you made the cut. Their new coordinator has been in the house twice this month, and it is landing with his family.

stories.headline: Beat writer: OL coach taking calls
stories.body: Quiet interest from two programs. Nothing formal yet, but his agent has been visible.

stories.headline: Pryor cleared, expected back for the rivalry week
stories.body: Full participation Wednesday. Training staff signed off. He took first-team reps in the walkthrough and looked like himself in the change-of-direction work.

stories.headline: Two mid-major starters enter, both list you
stories.body: A rotational edge and a two-year starting corner hit the portal Monday. Both have you in their early cut.

stories.headline: Defense holds late, your program escapes on the road
stories.body: Fourth-down stop with 1:12 left. Kobe Muzz had two of the three sacks. Offense punted on four of six second-half drives and it nearly cost the night.
